availabilityDefinitions.Unavailable: Rejected by the recovery CLI before output and absent from the public compile syntax enum.

compatibilityDefinitions.Unverified: Legacy characterization is not a compatibility contract or supported subset.

strategyDefinitions.limited-native-subset: Implement only a closed named grammar with strict errors outside it.
strategyDefinitions.remove-until-funded: Expose no adapter or ecosystem claim unless a later funded program accepts a new decision.

adapters.currentBoundary: Heuristic multi-pass byte preprocessing for variables, mixins, functions, control flow, nesting, placeholders, and selected built-ins before the inherited CSS parser.
knownRisks: Imports and selected directives are stripped without dependency or diagnostic output.
Brace, selector, comment, interpolation, and expression scans are not a canonical Sass lexer or evaluator.

adapters.currentBoundary: Line-oriented indentation conversion and dollar-variable substitution before the inherited CSS parser.
knownRisks: Selector versus property classification is inferred from punctuation instead of the indented Sass grammar.
Scope, modules, comments, strings, interpolation, and expression semantics are not modeled.

adapters.currentBoundary: Leading at-variable collection, textual declaration removal, and global byte substitution before the inherited CSS parser.
knownRisks: Variable and CSS at-rule identity is inferred from a short hard-coded name list.
Lexical scope, lazy evaluation, mixins, nesting, imports, strings, comments, and arithmetic are not a closed subset.

adapters.currentBoundary: Line-oriented indentation conversion and global dollar-variable replacement before the inherited CSS parser.
knownRisks: Optional punctuation and selector/property ambiguity are guessed from colons and leading bytes.
Variable parse errors are swallowed during scanning and unsupported constructs can disappear.

adapters.currentBoundary: Rewrites encountered legacy-AST class selectors with a name-only FNV-1a suffix.
knownRisks: Names are not file-specific and no owned module export mapping is produced.
Local/global scope, composition, values, dependencies, nested coverage, and collision policy are absent.

adapters.currentBoundary: Byte-scans backtick regions and object-like braces, deletes interpolation expressions, and sends the remaining bytes to the inherited CSS parser.
knownRisks: JavaScript and TypeScript lexical states, tagged-template identity, escapes, comments, regex literals, and nested expressions are not parsed.
Dynamic expressions are removed rather than represented or rejected.

adapters.currentBoundary: Fixed byte scanning for @apply plus deletion of selected at-rules before the inherited CSS parser; there is no JavaScript plugin host.
knownRisks: @custom-media and @nest constructs are skipped without a diagnostic or semantic expansion.
No plugin discovery, configuration, ordering, lifecycle, dependency, or source-map contract exists.

adapters.currentBoundary: A fixed in-memory utility table expands whitespace-separated names only when encountered by the PostCSS-like @apply scanner.
knownRisks: Unknown utilities are silently omitted from the expansion.
Content scanning, configuration, versions, variants, plugins, arbitrary values, ordering, and canonical Tailwind semantics are absent.
